appearance_facts.fact: Chart title is 'United States vs Canada'.
x-axis is labeled 'Characteristic' and displays years from 2012 to 2020.
Blue solid line with circular markers represents United States data.
Red dashed line with square markers represents Canada data.
The data point for United States in 2013 is labeled '1257.35'.
The data point for Canada in 2013 is labeled '434.33'.

printed_facts.fact: The year 2013 is marked on the x-axis.
The United States value for 2013 is 1257.35.

public_definitions: Use the public infrastructure grant application dashboard as the evidence source for deciding which 2013 country application volume is larger.

Review the public infrastructure grant application dashboard, compare the 2013 application volume for United States and Canada, then open the country grant intake follow-up record for the country with the larger 2013 volume.
